units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:5">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>הטל להן מים בס׳ וכ׳</he> pour water into a bowl for them (to drink from) &c., v. <cite ref="S01689"><he>קִעְקֵעַ</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Niddah 27a">Nidd. 27ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. III, 51ᵃ <he>במוציא את הס׳ וכ׳</he> when he carries away the basin (with the after-birth) &c.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="J00559"><he>יקה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Proverbs 30:1">Prov. XXX, 1</cite>) <he>כס׳ הזה שנתמלא בשעתו וכ׳</he> like a bowl which is filled in due time and emptied in due time, so did &c.; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>סְפָלִים</he>, <cite ref="O01357"><he>סְפָלִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 129b">Sabb. 129ᵇ</cite> the rich keep the after-birth <he>בס׳ של שמן</he> in basins filled with oil; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:3">Tosef. ib. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:3">XVI</cite>), 3 <he>בסופלי</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Berakhot 44a:5">Ber. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>סִפְלֵי טרית</he> basinfuls of salted fish.
Zeb. 91ᵇ לס׳ for the bowls (for libations); a. e.

senses.gloss: a frame stool or bench; also night-stool, interch. with סַפְסָל.
units: Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45 היה … יושב על הס׳ וכ׳ (ed. Bub. ספסל) the Philistine (to save himself from the attack of the mice) seated himself on a stool of bronze; והיה הס׳ נבקע וכ׳ and the stool burst of itself, and the mouse came up &c.; Midr. Sam. ch. X; Yalk. Sam. 102; Yalk. Kings 222 ספסל; Yalk. Ex. 183 ספסל; a. e.—Pl. as ab.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:3">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:3">VII</cite>), 3 <he>הס׳ והקתידראות</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>הסַפְסָלִין</he>) stools and chairs. Midr. Sam. l. c.; Yalk. Sam. l. c.; a. e.
